input: Draft a rental agreement for my spare room

gold.taskTitle: Draft a Rental Agreement for Your Spare Room
gold.taskDescription: Create a rental agreement document for the user's spare room to be used with a tenant.

questions.title: Who will be renting the spare room from you?
questions.description: Understand the relationship and details of the tenant — a stranger, friend, family member, or found via a listing platform.

questions.title: What is the full address of the property?
questions.description: Capture the exact address of the property where the spare room is located, needed for the legal document.

questions.title: What is the monthly rent amount and due date?
questions.description: Determine the agreed rent figure and which day of the month payment is expected.

questions.title: What is the intended start date and lease length?
questions.description: Establish when the tenancy begins and whether it is month-to-month, fixed-term, or another arrangement.

questions.title: Will you be collecting a security deposit from the tenant?
questions.description: Find out if a deposit is required, and if so, what the amount will be and any conditions for its return.

questions.title: Which utilities or amenities are included in the rent?
questions.description: Clarify whether Wi-Fi, electricity, water, laundry, parking, or other shared resources are covered or split separately.

questions.title: Which country and state or province is the property in?
questions.description: Identify the legal jurisdiction so the agreement can reflect the correct local tenancy laws and required clauses.
